vulnerability_cn: 整数类型转换错误导致付款方向反转
vulnerability_en: Unsafe unsigned-to-signed conversion reverses payment direction
detail_cn: give 将用户给出的 uint128 金额直接转成 int128 再取负数。历史调用传入 2^128-B，使 _transfer 收到正数 B，走储备提款而非用户入金分支；储备、Hub、攻击合约、攻击者之间的三笔 DAI 转账均为 24,882.995421947667857715 DAI。源码与历史 delegatecall 目标已对应；未独立重建攻击前全部状态，未重放。源表日期为 7 月 15 日，Ethereum 交易时间为 7 月 14 日 UTC；Polygon 参考交易尚未独立核查。
detail_en: give casts the caller-controlled uint128 amount to int128 and negates it without a range check. Historical calldata used 2^128-B, so _transfer received positive B and withdrew from the reserve instead of collecting a deposit. Three DAI transfers link reserve, Hub, attack contract and attacker for 24,882.995421947667857715 DAI. Public source is tied to the historical delegatecall target; complete pre-attack state and replay remain unverified. The sheet date is July 15, while the Ethereum transaction is July 14 UTC; the Polygon reference transaction was not independently checked.
loss_scope: Source-sheet reported approximate USD loss; raw DAI transfers are recorded separately.
